text:
Under the modern statutes in most states, the niece takes nothing. The "heirs of his body" language creates a fee tail, which those statutes convert into a fee simple absolute in the cousin, so the uncle kept no reversion to convey. Only the minority of states that still recognize fee tails would give the niece a reversion, and even there it springs back only if the cousin's bodily heirs die out.

CONFIDENCE: 80
